_readme: Auto-built from the real Wuoshi combat log of the Inquisitor 'Pawlith' (leveling-era kit). Ability NAMES match your log so the live advisor detects them. recast/duration are ROUGH estimates from cast gaps - tune them. Ordering = best-guess priority; reorder to taste (top = first). EXCLUDED as not player-pressed: Serenade / Dissonant Note / Precise Note (bard mercenary), Smite of Consistency (adornment proc), most 'Runic Armor' ticks (ward proc - kept once as a buff reminder). Add spells you have that aren't here (they only show up once you've cast them in the logged session). Fields: name, note, optional recast (s, priority/opener), duration (s, maintain->refresh), logName.
title: Inquisitor Rotation

roles.label: HEAL
roles.blurb: Keep the group up; weave a nuke when nobody needs healing.

maintain.name: Runic Armor
maintain.note: ward - keep it up if it's a spell you cast (verify)

opener.name: Ministration
opener.note: pre-heal the tank before the pull

priority.name: Resolute Flagellant
priority.note: 1) group cure - clear dangerous detrimentals FIRST

emergency.name: Ministration
emergency.note: biggest heal - tank about to die

cooldowns.name: Unholy Strike
cooldowns.note: lifetap hit+heal - extra healing while doing damage (verify)

roles.label: SOLO
roles.blurb: DoT + nuke, melee auto-attack, self-heal with Ministration as needed.

priority.name: Torment
priority.note: 1) keep the DoT ticking (recast is a rough guess)

priority.name: Unholy Strike
priority.note: 3) melee CA - hits and heals you (verify)

priority.name: auto-attack
priority.note: 5) stay in melee range between casts

cooldowns.name: Unholy Strike
cooldowns.note: use on cooldown for burst + self-heal (verify)

roles.label: GRP DPS
roles.blurb: Group has healing covered - push damage; toss a cure/heal only when needed.

priority.name: Torment
priority.note: 2) refresh the DoT when it drops

emergency.name: Resolute Flagellant
emergency.note: group cure if the healer is swamped

roles.label: RAID
